# Tech Science Press

> > Tech Science Press publishes open access academic journals spanning computational mechanics, computer systems, biological sciences, renewable materials, and engineering disciplines.

Tech Science Press is an academic publisher offering peer-reviewed open access journals including CMES (Computer Modeling in Engineering & Sciences), CSSE (Computer Systems Science and Engineering), BIOCELL, CHD (Congenital Heart Disease), JRM (Journal of Renewable Materials), JBD (Journal on Big Data), and SV (Sound & Vibration). The platform provides extensive archives of journal issues dating back to 2004, supporting research communities across computational, biological, and materials sciences.

## Current Journals

- [CSSE - Computer Systems Science and Engineering](https://www.techscience.com/journal/csse): Open access journal covering computer systems, software engineering, and computational science research
